card.name: Tea Cup
card.subject: A rich blue porcelain tea cup with a gold rim and a curved handle on a matching round saucer, steam rising.
card.hero_colors: rich cobalt blue, gold rim, white steam

card.name: Hat Box

card.hero_colors: rich crimson red, cream cord handle, navy blue lid

card.name: Top Hat
card.subject: A tall black silk top hat with a flat crown, a curled brim and a wide ribbon band.

card.name: Folding Fan

card.subject: A two-tier white porcelain cake stand with a round plate on each tier joined by a center post and a round foot, holding small iced cakes on both tiers.

card.surface_or_setting: a polished wooden floor against a cream wallpapered wall
